reviews.text:
The vet was reassuring and efficient.
Thanks to him, everything went well for Bidou.

I can't thank you enough 🙏

Very attentive and professional, very gentle with animals; you can really tell he's passionate about his work and doesn't do it for the money like some others. It really shows. I highly recommend him; you can go there with complete confidence.
All the staff there are very friendly and helpful, even on the phone.
My little bird, named Titi, had a sore leg; his claws were completely bent back. The vet, with great kindness and expertise, treated him, and he's doing wonderfully. I thank him very much.

I've been coming to this veterinary clinic for years and I always leave feeling reassured.

The two veterinarians are gentle and attentive, and they take the time for our animals.
The receptionists are always smiling and pleasant.
I highly recommend this clinic.

For more than 10 years and through the care of four cats, we've been fortunate to have this clinic looking after our family. Every member of the team—Andreu de Lapierre Etienne et al. and all the support staff—is exceptionally professional, kind, and caring.

Whether it's been urgent advice given without an appointment, clear explanations of procedures and treatment options, or just a knowing, reassuring human presence during difficult moments, they've always gone above and beyond. They're a positive, dedicated team that has consistently been there for us. You'll have to look hard to find a better veterinary practice.

For over ten years, and with four cats under their care, we've been lucky enough to rely on this clinic. The entire team—veterinarians as well as reception and support staff—demonstrates exemplary professionalism, great kindness, and genuine compassion. Whether it was for urgent advice given without an appointment and free of charge, clear explanations of possible treatments, or simply a reassuring presence during difficult times, we have always been supported with care and expertise. It's a dynamic, positive team, deeply dedicated to the well-being of both animals and their owners. We recommend them without hesitation.

I agree with @july's comment from December 2025. If you have rabbits, I strongly advise against going to this veterinary clinic. My rabbit had purulent discharge and incontinence. The vet (a young blonde woman), after taking an x-ray (she had a bladder stone), told me that given my rabbit's age (6 years old), I should consider possible euthanasia or emergency surgery. It's strange, she mentioned euthanasia but still presented me with a quote! Even though, despite the pain, she was still walking, eating, etc. Furthermore, the examination was rushed; she barely treated her hindquarters, didn't prescribe painkillers, and didn't even listen to her heart! Nothing! I went to see two other vets in the area. I went to a clinic in the 16th arrondissement and another in the 13th, Passion NAC, who told me my rabbit was healthy and had a chance of being saved. And thankfully, I followed my intuition; she had surgery at the Passion NAC clinic in the 13th. They are fantastic, and I highly recommend them! Today, my little one is doing wonderfully! If you have rodents, avoid them at all costs.
Dr. Etienne Andreu de Lapierre is an excellent veterinarian who took very good care of my rabbit. He also agreed to see a bird in an emergency.

So disappointed...

This morning at 8:45, I called the clinic and they told me to come in. For the past six years, I've taken Nina there for all her checkups and vaccinations, and everything has always gone smoothly.

But today, for a genuine emergency after my cat fell from the balcony, they told me to wait for all the scheduled appointments, explaining that the clinic isn't an emergency clinic. So I made the trip for nothing.

I then called the clinic on Boulevard Pasteur, which saw me immediately.

It's in moments like these that you really see which clinics are doing their best for the well-being of animals. I'm deeply disappointed by the lack of care, especially since I've trusted them for years.

Thank you to Dr. Andreu and his team for their professionalism, kindness, and availability. My dog, who has had several surgeries and developed numerous health problems, has always been well cared for. Each time, they listened attentively, provided accurate diagnoses, and my dog ​​is still with me and doing as well as possible. I highly recommend this clinic.

This clinic is fantastic: the reception is very quick and they are so kind to the animals! The veterinary assistants are professional and readily available.
Thank you to Dr. Andreu de Lapierre and a special thank you to Tsilah for the care she gave my cat Bounty.

I am heartbroken. Lune, my daughter's guinea pig, has just passed away after being hospitalized at the Andreu De Lapierre Etienne veterinary clinic.

Lune had lost weight but remained active. I took her to the vet on Tuesday. After an X-ray, they advised me to keep her for rehydration, force-feeding, monitoring, and dental imaging.
Each time they were supposed to call me, they never did. Every day, the vet was unavailable, they refused to release the animal, but no one called me back.
On Friday, the vet met with me; the appointment was at 2:30 p.m., but I wasn't seen until 3:15 p.m. After an exorbitant bill and the purchase of two medications, I left feeling somewhat hopeful, but having been informed that Lune would need dental care every six weeks for the rest of her life. They had cleverly placed Lune directly into her travel bag, ready to go. When I got home, I found my pet much thinner than four days earlier, completely lethargic, panting. I could see things weren't going well at all, but my daughter and I gave him the care he needed.
This morning, as I approached his cage, I heard him panting heavily. When I picked him up, his body and head were drooping. Lune panted several more times, for a long time. Then Lune took his last breath in our arms. Four days and three nights of hospitalization at Dr. Andreu De Lapiette Etienne's clinic finally finished him off completely. Between the constant coming and going of the numerous staff members in a cramped space, surrounded by tons of shelves of medications, food, and supplies, the agitated and extremely noisy receptionist, and everyone's obvious lack of time, there was little space, time, or peace for Lune. I don't understand why you refused to give him back to us after the dental imaging. And why tell us he ate cucumber when he clearly didn't? You need to choose between medicine and business, sir; you'll get less confused among the different guinea pigs you're in charge of!
Dr. Andrieu truly loves animals; he is competent and readily available. I highly recommend him.

Excellent Veterinary Clinic
I brought my rabbits to Dr. Andreu de Lapierre's veterinary clinic in an emergency.
Dr. Andreu and his staff (Tsilah, Lina, and Victoria) were kind and reassuring. They listened attentively and clearly explained what was happening with my hospitalized animals, as well as with my tortoise, which they had cared for very well four years ago.

I felt completely confident in their care.

A big thank you to the entire veterinary team.

A very bad experience, to be avoided for small birds.

I am sharing my experience here to inform other small bird owners.

I brought my budgie in for a consultation because of a swollen leg, a few days after a leg band removal performed at another veterinary clinic.
During the consultation, the veterinarian repeatedly stated that he could not comment on the condition of the leg, as he had not performed the initial procedure. To each of my questions about the possible outcome, he systematically replied, "I can't tell you, I don't know."
After these responses, the consultation could have ended there.

However, the veterinarian then made abrupt movements in the cage, repeatedly inserting his hand, moving it, and waving it around, without explanation or justification. We were dealing with a small, timid bird, whose leg was already weakened. My bird repeatedly gripped the cage bars in a sign of panic and distress, despite its injury. Despite this, the same actions were continued without any adjustment or interruption of the handling.

When I pointed out to the vet that this type of handling was not a way to catch a bird, he replied that he wasn't trying to catch it, without offering any explanation for the purpose of this manipulation.
These abrupt, unnecessary, and counterproductive movements caused my bird severe panic. Significant bleeding then occurred.
The veterinarian then administered sedation and applied a bandage to the leg.

At no point during this consultation was I informed of the potential seriousness of blood loss in a small bird, nor of the possible consequences, nor of the signs to watch for afterward (particularly respiratory), nor of the need for emergency veterinary care should the condition worsen. After this significant blood loss, my bird's condition gradually deteriorated over the following days, with the onset of respiratory difficulties.

I then rushed him to an emergency veterinary clinic specializing in exotic pets. They explained that, in such a small bird, significant blood loss can lead to respiratory complications that may appear several days later. This information had not been provided to me during the initial consultation, even though it would have allowed me to be prepared and to monitor his progress appropriately.
This respiratory deterioration, which appeared in the days following the hemorrhage, ultimately led to his death.
Despite this emergency care, my bird died the next day.

Hello, a veterinarian and his colleagues, including a fantastic young vet! They know how to care for a sick, terminally ill cat, providing optimal treatment, as well as a lively, fluffy young kitten. They also know how to handle the loss of a loved one. A warm welcome and professional service. Sincerely.

I wanted to thank your team for the extensive care provided to Marie Antoinette, known as "Mimi." We arrived safely in Cameroon. She is continuing her treatment and is doing very well; she has regained her vitality, appetite, and calm. Thank you all so much for your warm welcome and prompt attention.

I have no words to express my gratitude to this clinic. I won't go into details, but following the story of my little Biscotte, who was found and taken in by this clinic, where she received excellent care with so much tenderness... a huge thank you also to the nurse who contacted me and alerted me (unfortunately, I don't know her name). I could feel how much she loves animals and that for her, it's more than just a job. I've rarely seen a clinic like this. Thank you so much!

The entire staff at the clinic is incredible. We have two cats and a dog who have always been pampered here. Our animals are no longer stressed when they are at the clinic. Tsilah, Lina, and Victoria are kind and attentive and treat our animals like their own. My dog ​​is especially happy every time we come. Our animals have all had rather unusual health problems, and Dr. Andreu has always been very efficient and puts our animals' best interests first. He has always been accommodating with payment arrangements, even though the fees could sometimes be quite high given the serious health issues our animals have. He also found a solution for my dog's skin condition, which we had been struggling with for two years, and he always offers us less expensive alternatives. Two years ago, we brought our rabbit to them after he had been neglected by another vet. His condition was unfortunately too advanced to be saved. The doctor was honest and did everything he could to save him. The team was very respectful and supported us through our grief. Dr. Berthet, despite her relatively recent arrival, also does excellent work; she is empathetic and kind.

Thank you.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. I have a dog and two cats who are patients there, and despite stressful situations, I'm always reassured knowing they'll be well cared for. The doctor is honest, always looking for solutions with you, and transparent about prices. And the team is fantastic; they're always so attentive to my pets (they give them little treats every time). A big thank you again to Dr. Andreu, Dr. Berthet, Tsillah, Lina, and Victoria. Here are a few photos to show how happy my dog ​​is when she's there!

Excellent veterinary clinic. My cat, Jean-Christophe, was treated with great gentleness and professionalism!

A huge thank you to the two veterinarians for their attentiveness, kindness, and clear explanations. The entire team is reassuring and very caring. You can feel their genuine love for animals and their dedication to their care. I highly recommend this clinic.
Excellent veterinary clinic, the team is super welcoming and the vets are amazing!

My cat was taken to this clinic for emergency care. The reception was very reassuring: I was extremely panicked, but despite their workload, the nurses were very welcoming, caring, and available. They took the time to reassure me and answer all my questions with great professionalism and kindness. Thanks to them, I felt listened to and confident during what was a very stressful time.

A huge thank you to Dr. Andreu de Lapierre and Dr. Berthet, as well as their three veterinary assistants.

They all took care of my cat Cookie with professionalism, patience, and love. 🐈🐱 Excellent diagnosis and thorough follow-up.
We will definitely be back. 🐾😻

A huge thank you to the clinic for providing such prompt and thorough care for my little cat! The staff were very polite and professional, clearly very knowledgeable in their field – it was extremely reassuring!

I am posting this notice primarily to warn rabbit owners.

When a rabbit is brought in for a consultation, it is often already serious, as these animals mask their suffering until a very advanced stage.

If no clear diagnosis is made, if explanations are lacking or vague, and if you have to drag information out of them to understand the procedures and treatments, it is essential to consult another veterinarian quickly.
Don't hesitate to request a second opinion, ideally from a practice truly equipped for exotic pets (dental and body imaging, X-rays, blood tests, in-depth examinations), as this can be crucial. Minimal follow-up in the face of serious symptoms can waste precious time.
Also, pay attention to the receptionist's attitude: when legitimate requests for explanations are met with dismissiveness or remarks like "go somewhere else," it raises questions about the overall operation of the practice. In these situations, it's important to ask the right questions and act quickly, because with rabbits, silence is never synonymous with the absence of suffering.

The platform requires a minimum of one star rating to post a review.

This review is therefore intended as a warning, relevant for rabbit owners, but also, more broadly, for any pet owner facing a serious medical situation.

I could go into detail about what my pet went through during its treatment, but the main reason I'm posting this review today is that the experience at this clinic doesn't reflect the level of vigilance and transparency one has the right to expect when dealing with a seriously ill animal.
This experience was marked by a lack of comprehensive and clearly defined care, leaving the owner to figure things out, follow up, and raise the alarm repeatedly, despite their constant involvement in the care. When difficulties were reported, responsibility seemed to gradually shift to the owner, instead of leading to a structured medical reassessment.

Dr. Andreu is always available to take care of my rabbits; we can count on him for emergencies. The team is very welcoming, and a special mention goes to Tsilah, who always takes the time to explain things clearly. She's a pillar of this clinic.

I was very satisfied with the care my rabbit received for its neutering and vaccination.

I would particularly like to emphasize the calm, patience, and professionalism of the staff and the veterinarian when dealing with a particularly agitated and impolite client.
A serious and trustworthy team that I highly recommend.

If you refuse to have your pet vaccinated (with mRNA and graphene, but they obviously don't know the components), they consider it no longer under their care, even if you've been going there for a long time. If you go there to have your nails trimmed, they make them bleed, and they don't even apologize. You should see the shrews at reception who do it...

A huge thank you to Dr. Andreu Lapierre. He saw my dog ​​immediately as an emergency, even though it was late, and his intervention was crucial to her recovery. His passion for animals is evident, and he demonstrates exemplary kindness and professionalism. He responded to my emails in under 10 minutes, even late at night, to check on her well-being.
His services are expensive, but they are truly worth it for the quality of care and attention he provides. I highly recommend this veterinarian for his attentiveness, responsiveness, and dedication!

Trinity is recovering slowly but surely. This morning she decided to eat on her own again. With the right treatment, miracles happen. A big thank you to all the members of the clinic for your professionalism.
Excellent veterinarian, calm, attentive, and above all very effective.

This clinic is completely incompetent and I would not recommend it. The vet is only after money and has no interest in animals. There are many more competent, welcoming, and trustworthy vets in the 14th arrondissement.

My cat Gaia has been a patient at this clinic for 5 years and I am delighted with the care she receives. Special mention goes to the young veterinarian with short hair who gives sound and realistic advice, takes the time to examine the animal gently, and talks with me. I feel confident, and that is immensely valuable. Thank you!
Efficient and caring veterinarian for my dog ​​who was seen as an emergency due to a bite.

If you're looking for an excellent veterinarian, you've come to the right place. Highly competent, attentive, and responsive, I'm glad to have him in my neighborhood. My cat's surgeries have always gone very well, and the follow-up care is outstanding. I highly recommend him!
Very friendly welcome

A very reputable clinic with a caring and highly professional team.
My cat has been a patient there for two years and I highly recommend them!

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Exatys veterinary clinic! My guinea pig was in critical condition, and thanks to their quick response, gentleness, and professionalism, he was saved. You can tell that the animals there are truly loved and well cared for. The staff took the time to explain each step to me with patience and kindness.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, especially if you have a small pet like a guinea pig. Thank you again for everything ❤️🐹

Amazing clinic, they saved my dog.
Thank you to them.
Excellent consultations, provides quick and effective solutions
A very warm welcome and the veterinarian, Mr. Andreu de Lapierre, was very attentive. It's reassuring for both the owner and the dog. I highly recommend them.

I chose this vet for my gerbils a few years ago because I wanted a specialist in exotic pets, and since then he's also been treating our cat and ferret. We have complete confidence in this vet; it's clear that animal welfare is truly important to him. He has always given us excellent advice on what's best for them, and he doesn't impose anything on pet owners. He lets them make the decisions, explaining the different options and what's best for them. He's also very responsive with email advice, which is very convenient in case of an emergency or for follow-up care.

When my first gerbil developed a tumor (the exact cause wasn't clear at first), he initially tried to treat her in the least stressful and aggressive way possible to protect her. Although she ultimately couldn't be saved because she was too fragile, my second gerbil, who had the same health issue a few months later, was able to recover and live out her days in good old age.

He also gave us excellent advice for our ferret, so we come to him with complete confidence. Thank you so much!

Mr. Andreu de Lapierre and his team are very competent and very kind.
Our animal friends are in good hands!
Thank you for Ulys!

I recommend this clinic for any veterinary needs, whether for annual checkups or emergencies.
Excellent vet! You can feel the vet's love for animals and they do their utmost to care for them. Go there without hesitation.
Excellent veterinarian, efficient and attentive. He has been taking care of our cat for several years and we are completely satisfied. I highly recommend him!
Thank you 🤩🙏 …

I went to apply for a passport for my cat, and the vet went out of their way to make sure my cat could travel. They are straightforward, honest, kind, and professional.
Thank you for the excellent service.

My vet for many years, who treated my deceased cat and my current cat (16 years old!). Always gives sound advice, doesn't push unnecessary treatments, and listens to both the animal and its owner. I highly recommend him!
The welcome was unpleasant, impersonal, and unfriendly. I miss the previous team, who were much warmer and more welcoming. One wonders what their attitude is towards our animals...

Dr. Andreu is exceptional and highly competent, empathetic, and his assistants are warm, attentive, and efficient.
My dog, Huang Di, has been a patient at this practice for a year and a half, and I am completely satisfied.
Well done to the whole team!
Sylvia Houdet
Very humane. A good listener.

This is a clinic that truly cares about animals of all kind. We found an injured bird on the street and, while other vets had told us to just leave the poor bird to its destiny, this vet kindly agreed to help us. Staff was tremendously kind and friendly. We are very grateful.

J
He has been my vet for many years. He cares as much about animals as he does about humans. With his team, the doctor extended the life of my Carlos by two years …
